newsitem.title: USA: Campbell Soup's Dorrance sells 3.4 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Campbell Soup's Dorrance sells 3.4 mln shrs.

text.p: John Dorrance, heir to the Campbell Soup Co fortune said on Thursday that he sold 3,400,000 common shares in the company, reducing his stake to 15,875,981 common, or 6.4 percent from 7.8 percent held previously.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Dorrance, who retired from the board in 1995, said he has sold the shares since October 7 at a price of $78 in open market or private sales.
Dorrance, a citizen of Ireland, has said he would sell more shares as opportunities arose and when economically advantageous.
Campbell's last traded on the New York Stock Exchange at $78.50 per share.
